hero.filename: Manor House Signal Cabin near Thirsk, England.jpg
hero.caption: Block signal cabin north of Thirsk, England, where an express passenger train collided with a freight train after the signalman had fallen asleep. He had spent his previous rest day searching for medical help for his infant daughter, who died later that day.
